prompt: Which combination fits the guide for the second clip Mina is making?
promptZh: 依照指南，哪一種做法符合 Mina 正在製作的第二段影片？

options.text: Use Replay and rely on the label shown before the first rush.
options.zh: 用重播，單靠第一波尖峰前出現的標籤。
options.whyZh: 重播適合呈現佇列變化，但若末段有特寫，不能只依賴開場標籤。

options.text: Use Preview and add a source card before the close-up.
options.zh: 用預覽，在特寫前加上來源字卡。
options.whyZh: 字卡處理方式正確，但要展示訂單佇列隨時間的變化，應使用重播。

options.text: Use Replay and add a source card before the close-up.
options.zh: 用重播，在特寫前加上來源字卡。
options.whyZh: 由聊天得知第二段要呈現尖峰間佇列變化且末段是特寫；指南分別要求重播與在特寫前補來源字卡。

options.text: Use Preview and add a source card only after the close-up.
options.zh: 用預覽，等特寫結束後才補來源字卡。
options.whyZh: 所選模式不符時間序列目的，字卡也是在特寫前而非之後。

explanationZh: 由聊天得知第二段要呈現尖峰間佇列變化且末段是特寫；指南分別要求重播與在特寫前補來源字卡。
evidence: Use a replay to show how the queue changed over time, not to show how an operator edits an order. / If the clip ends with a close-up, add a title card naming the source before that portion; a source label shown only at the very beginning is not enough. / For the second, I need to show the queue growing from the first rush to the second. / I will crop the last six seconds for a close-up.

vocabulary.note: 將視野拉近，留下畫面的局部細節。
